type-scale

Fluid type from utopia.fyi. Two scales share the --step-n names: "read" (the default: 16px to 17px body) for pages that are read, and data-density="tool" (12px to 14px body) for dense tools. Blocks read the --text-* roles, which point at the right step in each scale, so a block never knows which scale is active. Set data-density on the root, or on any element to switch one surface.

space-scale

Fluid space from utopia.fyi: the house scale 4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64 96 at a phone, growing a little with the type. One scale for both densities. Pairs (--space-s-l) grow from one step to another across the viewport; --gutter is the page's outer padding.

typefaces

Two typefaces: Switzer (Fontshare, 300 to 600) for all text, Montagu Slab Light (Google) only for display: a page or app name, dialog titles, big numerals. The stylesheet does not load them; add the font links from AGENTS.md to the page's head.

--font-monoInk on paper, and its dark twin 0123456789

controls-and-motion

The focus ring, control padding and the one quiet transition. Control padding is in em, so a control tightens with the tool density's smaller type.

src/tokens/misc.css

theme

Colour roles for the light look and its dark twin. The page follows the system setting; data-theme="light" or "dark" on the root (set by cm-theme-toggle) overrides it, and on any other element pins that surface to one look.

Pinned to the dark twin, whatever the page is: for a surface read on camera or in the dark.

Roles resolve again inside it.

  <p>Pinned to the dark twin, whatever the page is: for a surface read on camera or in the dark.</p>
  <p class="tone-muted">Roles resolve again inside it.</p>
</div>

Base elements

reset

A small modern reset (after Andy Bell's): border-box sizing, no default margins on text, media that fits its container, controls that inherit the page's type. Spacing between elements comes from composition (stack, cluster), never from an element's own margin.

src/reset/reset.css

page

The page itself: ink on paper in Switzer at the body step, an inverted selection, one focus ring, and no motion for people who asked for none.

src/defaults/root.css

typography

Text elements with no class. h1 is the display face (a page or app name); other headings are Switzer at weight 500. A link with no class is ink over a 1px rule, turning muted on hover.

src/defaults/typography.css

controls

Native form controls with no class: square, one rule colour. Hovering a field turns its border muted and the field you are in takes the ink. A plain button has a rule border; for the main action or a quiet one, see the button block.

  <input type="text" placeholder="Text" aria-label="Text">
  <select aria-label="Choice"><option>One</option><option>Two</option></select>
  <button type="button">Button</button>
  <input type="checkbox" checked aria-label="Checked">
  <input type="radio" checked aria-label="Chosen">
  <progress value="0.6" aria-label="Progress"></progress>
</div>

Tokens
--space-s
Do
Nest stacks with different data-space values to group related things.
Don’t
Put margins on the children; the stack owns the space between them.

cluster

Things in a row that wrap when they run out of room: buttons, a title and its actions, meta.

One
Two
Three

Tokens
--space-s
Do
Add data-push="end" to a child to send it, and everything after it, to the far end.
Don’t

center

A centred column with a maximum width. With data-gutter it is the page wrapper.

src/composition/center.css

A column no wider than the measure, centred in its parent.

</div>
Properties
--center-max The maximum width. Default: --measure (65ch).
Tokens
--measure --gutter
Do
Set --center-max on the element for a wider page: style="--center-max: 65rem".
Don’t
Nest a center in a center to add padding; use data-gutter once, on the outer one.

sidebar

Two columns, one narrow and one that takes the rest. They stack when the wide one would get narrower than its minimum, with no breakpoint.

--sidebar-content-min The wide column's minimum share before they stack. Default: 55%.

Crops media to an aspect ratio, so a row of images or videos lines up whatever their sizes.

space

The data-space attribute shared by stack, cluster, sidebar, switcher, grid, cover and reel: one name for the space between children, taking any step or pair of the space scale.

Blocks

label

The small uppercase label: field names, column heads, section heads. With data-rule it is a section head, a label over a 1px rule.

src/components/label.css

Recent runs

Markup 
<h2 class="label">Recent runs</h2>
Tokens
--text-label --tracking-label --muted --space-2xs --rule
Do
Put it on the element that carries the meaning: a heading for a section head, a span inside a field.
Don’t
Use it for sentences or body text; uppercase is for a few words.

display

The display face, Montagu Slab Light, on anything that is not an h1: an app name, a dialog title, a big numeral.

src/components/display.css

Teleprompter

Markup 
<p class="display">Teleprompter</p>
Tokens
--font-display --text-title --text-display --leading-display --tracking-display
Do
Keep it to one or two per view; it marks the name of the thing.
Don’t
Set body text, labels or buttons in it.

button

An action. A view has one primary button, filled ink; everything secondary is a quiet text button. Works on a button or a link.

src/components/button.css

Markup 
<button type="button" class="button">Start</button>
Tokens
--control-pad-block --control-pad-inline --space-2xs --rule --bg --fg --hover --soft --muted --duration --ease
Do
Write the label as a verb: Start, Save, Download and install.
Don’t
Put two primary buttons in one view, or use an ✕ where a quiet "Close" fits.

link

The link look, ink over a 1px rule and muted on hover, for a link that carries a class (the classless default does not reach it) and for a button that reads as a link.

src/components/link.css

Full history
Markup 
<a class="link" href="#block-link">Full history</a>
Tokens
--fg --muted --duration --ease
Do
Leave a link in running text with no class; it has this look already.
Don’t
Use it for a secondary action such as Close or Undo; that is the quiet button.

field

A form control with its name. Wrap the control in a label so no id is needed. A checkbox or radio sits beside its text, which is muted until hovered.

</label>
Tokens
--space-3xs --space-2xs --muted --fg --duration --ease
Do
Name a text field with a label block; name a checkbox with plain text after the input.
Don’t
Use a placeholder as the only name of a field.

dot

A small round status dot. Colour means state only: teal for ok or live, yellow for asking or loading, red for trouble, muted grey for idle.

--muted --ok --ask --trouble --duration --ease

toolbar

A row of controls over a rule, between a view's title and its content. It wraps on a narrow screen.

--space-xs --space-m --space-s --rule
Do
Add data-push="end" to the primary action to send it to the far end.
Don’t
Give it role="toolbar"; that role promises arrow-key navigation this block does not add.

nav

A row of links between a site's or a tool's views. The current view is ink over a rule; the others are muted.

src/components/nav.css

Brief Routines Ledger
Markup 
<nav class="nav" aria-label="Views">
  <a href="#block-nav" aria-current="page">Brief</a>
  <a href="#block-nav">Routines</a>
  <a href="#block-nav">Ledger</a>
</nav>
Tokens
--space-2xs --space-m --muted --fg --duration --ease
Do
Mark the current view with aria-current="page"; that attribute is the state.
Don’t
Add an "active" class; assistive technology cannot read a class.

popover

A panel over the page for settings or detail: an ink border, a soft shadow, a display title and a quiet Close. On a dialog element it is modal and dims the page; on an element with the popover attribute it is light: the page stays as it is, and it closes when you click away. Both open and close with no JavaScript.

src/components/popover.css

Other models

Apple's on-device model is the default and needs no download.
Markup 
<button type="button" class="button" commandfor="example" command="show-modal">Other models</button>
<dialog class="popover" id="example" aria-labelledby="example-title">
  <header>
    <h2 id="example-title">Other models</h2>
    <form method="dialog"><button class="button" data-variant="quiet">Close</button></form>
  </header>
  <div class="stack">
    <p>Apple's on-device model is the default and needs no download.</p>
  </div>
</dialog>
States
data-anchor On a popover-attribute panel: opens beside the button that opened it, not in the middle of the page.
Properties
--popover-width The panel's width. Default: 35rem, never wider than the screen less a margin.
Tokens
--bg --fg --shadow --backdrop --space-m --space-3xs --space-s --space-2xs --font-display --text-title --leading-display --tracking-display
Do
Open a dialog with commandfor and command="show-modal", and a light panel with popovertarget.
Don’t
Close it with an ✕ icon, nest one in another, or rebuild it from divs; the native elements trap focus and close on Esc.

theme-toggle

The half-filled circle, top right, that flips the page between the light look and its dark twin. The button inside a cm-theme-toggle element, which gives it its behaviour.

  <button type="button" class="theme-toggle" aria-label="Dark mode" aria-pressed="false">
    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M8 1.75a6.25 6.25 0 0 1 0 12.5z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
  </button>
</cm-theme-toggle>
Tokens
--muted --fg --duration --ease
Without JavaScript
hidden — Without JavaScript the toggle is not shown and the page follows the system setting.
Do
Put it at the end of the page's title row, once per page.
Don’t
Add a label next to it or a third "system" state; choosing the system's own look again forgets the choice.

titlebar

A view's or a list's title row: the title, then a count or controls, over an ink rule. It wraps on a narrow screen. For a row of controls with no title, see toolbar.

--space-2xs --space-s --fg
Do

disclosure

A details element whose summary carries a drawn plus that becomes a minus when it is open, in place of the browser's triangle. For a row or a section that folds away.

src/components/disclosure.css

Brief and tags

What this board is for, what to take from it, what to ignore.

--space-xs --muted
Do
Give several details the same name attribute when only one should be open at a time.
Don’t
Open or close it from a script; the native element answers clicks, Enter and Space already.

chip

A small boxed word: a tag, a dependency, a filter. On a span it is a fact, in muted text; on a link or a button it is an action, in ink, and a pressed or current one is filled.

Custom elements

cm-theme-toggle

The behaviour of the theme toggle: flips data-theme on the root between light and dark, keeps aria-pressed on its button in step, and stores the choice under "cm-theme" in localStorage.

src/elements/cm-theme-toggle.js

Markup 
<cm-theme-toggle>
  <button type="button" class="theme-toggle" aria-label="Dark mode" aria-pressed="false">
    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="8" cy="8" r="6.25" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.2"/><path d="M8 1.75a6.25 6.25 0 0 1 0 12.5z" fill="currentColor"/></svg>
  </button>
</cm-theme-toggle>
Events
{CustomEvent<{theme: 'light' | 'dark'}>} cm-theme-change - On the document, after the theme flips.
Without JavaScript
hidden — Without JavaScript the toggle is not shown and the page follows the system setting.
Do
Load theme-init.js in the head as well, so a stored choice is applied before the page paints.
Don’t
Give it anything but one button to wrap, or set data-theme on the root from your own code.

Utilities

visually-hidden

Hides text from the screen but keeps it for screen readers: a name for an icon button, a heading for a section that needs none visually.

src/utils/utils.css

The next words are read aloud but not shown: here they are.

Markup 
<p>The next words are read aloud but not shown<span class="visually-hidden">: here they are</span>.</p>

tone

Text colour by role: muted or soft for quiet text, and the three state colours in their text-safe shades. State colours are for state, never decoration.

src/utils/utils.css

Soft: a lead or a secondary paragraph.

Muted: meta, hints, counts.

Ok: installed, done, live.

Ask: waiting on you, loading.

Trouble: it failed.

Markup 
<div class="stack" data-space="3xs">
  <p class="tone-soft">Soft: a lead or a secondary paragraph.</p>
  <p class="tone-muted">Muted: meta, hints, counts.</p>
  <p class="tone-ok">Ok: installed, done, live.</p>
  <p class="tone-ask">Ask: waiting on you, loading.</p>
  <p class="tone-trouble">Trouble: it failed.</p>
</div>

tabular

Numerals of equal width, so a number that changes does not shift its neighbours and columns line up. Tables, time and output elements have it already.

src/utils/utils.css

1,204 words · about 9 min

Markup 
<p class="tabular">1,204 words · about 9 min</p>

measure

Keeps running text to a readable line length (--measure, 65 characters).

src/utils/utils.css

A paragraph that would otherwise run the full width of a wide container stops at a comfortable line length, however wide the page gets, because long lines are hard to follow back to the start of the next one.

Markup 
<p class="measure">A paragraph that would otherwise run the full width of a wide container stops at a comfortable line length, however wide the page gets, because long lines are hard to follow back to the start of the next one.</p>
